Holzbaurechner / Pallet bed

Pallet bed calculator

How many standard 48 × 40 in. pallets you need for a bed frame, how big and how high it gets and what it costs, from twin to California king.

How the pallet bed is built

The calculator uses the standard North American GMA pallet, 48 × 40 in. and about 4-3/4 in. high, with three stringers and seven top deck boards. It tries both orientations and picks the one that needs the fewest pallets for your mattress. One layer gives a low platform bed, two or three layers a more comfortable height. Pallets stood on end make a headboard.

Finding good pallets

Look for the HT stamp of the IPPC mark, which means the pallet was heat treated. Avoid pallets stamped MB (fumigated with methyl bromide), painted or stained pallets and any that carried food, chemicals or oil. Hardware stores, garden centers and small businesses often give pallets away. New pallets cost about $10 to $20.

Building the pallet bed step by step

  1. Clean: scrub the pallets with soapy water and let them dry for several days.
  2. Sand: sand the top faces and all edges you will touch, and set any protruding nails.
  3. Finish: seal with a clear water-based finish or paint so the wood does not shed splinters or dust.
  4. Assemble: lay out the first layer, join the pallets with mending plates, stack the next layer and screw the layers together.
  5. Protect the floor: put felt pads under the bottom layer so the bed does not scratch the floor.

Frequently asked questions

How many pallets do I need for a queen bed?
A queen mattress (60 × 80 in.) fits on four pallets per layer, two by two with the 40 in. side across the bed. The base is then 80 × 96 in. With two layers you need eight pallets.
How many pallets for a king bed?
A king mattress (76 × 80 in.) also fits on four pallets per layer, laid two by two for an 80 × 96 in. base. A California king (72 × 84 in.) needs the same four pallets.
Is a pallet bed bad for the mattress?
The gaps between the deck boards let air under the mattress, which is good. With a memory foam mattress, lay a sheet of plywood or a slatted base on top so the foam is supported evenly.

Lumber sizes follow the span tables of the 2021 International Residential Code (IRC) and are planning values. They do not replace a permit review or an engineer. Decks, patio covers and carports usually need a building permit, so check with your local building department.
